what: The 1.0 round's NVIDIA timing rows on compute capability 8.6: the identical-case ladder (pml_3d at the three sizes of record, both routes, three passes, the MEEP controls of the 1.0 round) and the fused-product rows the dispatch-preference records are cut from (every DRIVE case the release dispatches, and the size sweep).

ladder.binding: bound is the 1.0 binding probe's choice on this host type; a new host runs the probe once (timing_ladder.py --tiers bindprobe) and its catalog names the binding chosen
